stem.en: Dye is poured into a sinkhole on a limestone hill. Later the dye appears in a stream at a cave mouth lower down the hill. What does this show?

text.en: The sinkhole water dried up, and new water appeared.

feedback.en: The dye could not reach the stream unless the same water carried it there.

text.en: The water ran over the surface, down the hillside.

feedback.en: The stream vanished into the ground at the sinkhole, so it did not cross the top.

text.en: The water travelled through passages in the hill.

feedback.en: Yes. The sinkhole and the cave mouth are two ends of one route.

text.en: The dye climbed up through the rock by itself.

feedback.en: The cave mouth is lower down, and it was the water that carried the dye.

explanation.en: Dye follows water. It went in at the sinkhole and came out at the cave mouth, so the water crossed the hill through connected passages. A river that flows through a cave system is an underground river.

hints.en: What must connect the place it went in and the place it came out?
